description: This file implements a Linux kernel driver for accessing B53 switch registers via SPI. It contains functions for reading and writing various widths of data, managing SPI communication, and initializing/removing the driver.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read_reg(struct spi_device * spi,u8 reg,u8 * val,unsigned len)
methods.description: Performs a SPI transfer to read a register value from the B53 device.

methods.name: int b53_spi_clear_status(struct spi_device * spi)
methods.description: Clears the SPI status register, retrying if necessary.

methods.name: int b53_spi_set_page(struct spi_device * spi,u8 page)
methods.description: Sets the register access page on the device.

methods.name: int b53_prepare_reg_access(struct spi_device * spi,u8 page)
methods.description: Prepares the device for register access by clearing status and setting page.

methods.name: int b53_spi_prepare_reg_read(struct spi_device * spi,u8 reg)
methods.description: Prepares the device for reading a specific register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * data,unsigned len)
methods.description: Reads data from a specified register and page, supports multiple data widths.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
int b53_spi_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register value and converts from little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register value and converts from little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit register value and converts from little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit register value and converts from little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register, encoding in little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a register, encoding in little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value to a register, encoding in little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to a register, encoding in little endian.

methods.name: int b53_spi_probe(struct spi_device * spi)
methods.description: Initializes the SPI driver for the B53 device during probe.

methods.name: int b53_spi_remove(struct spi_device * spi)
methods.description: Removes the driver and cleans up resources.
